title: Severe / emergency teaching case: anterior STEMI with proximal LAD occlusion

presentation.initial_troponin_summary: Initial troponin may be pending early after symptom onset; later simulated samples rise substantially. Do not delay emergency pathway selection while waiting for a biomarker when the ECG and clinical context indicate STEMI.
